purpose: Quality-only class-map comparison on D-independent chicken and zebrafish chromosomes using the matched NTv2 class checkpoint and any completed native whole-genome outputs; unavailable native cells remain explicit NA.

backbone.name: NTv2-500M
backbone.checkpoint_contract: validation-selected best_model from class job 12889091; no test or chromosome score selection
backbone.token_projection: representation trainer sequence_tokens: six-base tokens plus a final shorter token, non-ACGT token mapped to native <unk>
backbone.prediction: native 8-class token argmax projected back to covered bases; no threshold or calibration

RM2.coordinate_contract: RepeatMasker .out fields 5/6 are 1-based inclusive and converted to 0-based half-open
RM2.non_te_policy: Simple_repeat, Low_complexity, Satellite and RNA-like classes are skipped as non-TE; explicit Unknown/? remain UNCLASSIFIED/AMBIGUOUS
RM2.overlap_policy: sort by (start,end,ontology_label_id), then ordered paint; later row wins; no reference labels are consulted

EDTA.coordinate_contract: GFF3 fields 3/4 are 1-based inclusive and converted to 0-based half-open
EDTA.parent_policy: Skip region/chromosome/contig and structural child rows; suppress a repeat_region container only when a complete TE child or explicit match-part evidence replaces it; retain complete TE bodies such as LTR_retrotransposon even when they carry structural LTR/TIR children
EDTA.non_te_policy: Explicit simple/low-complexity/satellite/RNA-like classes are skipped; explicit Unknown/? remain UNCLASSIFIED/AMBIGUOUS
EDTA.overlap_policy: sort by (start,end,ontology_label_id), then ordered paint; later row wins; no reference labels are consulted

evaluation.callable_mask: only A/C/G/T bases; N and other IUPAC bases are excluded from class denominators and reported separately
evaluation.source_mapping: same frozen SF5 ontology policy as the matched class trainer: BG default, SINE/LINE/LTR/DNA main classes, RC/Retroposon KNOWN_OTHER_TE, ? AMBIGUOUS_TE, Unknown/Unspecified/unresolved UNCLASSIFIED
evaluation.source_overlap_policy: sort source intervals by (start,end,ontology_label_id), then ordered paint; later row wins
evaluation.primary_known_endpoint: macro metrics over reference BG/SINE/LINE/LTR/DNA positions only; source KNOWN_OTHER_TE, AMBIGUOUS_TE and UNCLASSIFIED positions are excluded from this denominator
evaluation.full8_endpoint: 8-by-8 reference-row/prediction-column confusion on all callable bases; source Unknown/UNCLASSIFIED remains an explicit row
evaluation.true_te_endpoint: conditional readout on reference SINE/LINE/LTR/DNA bases, with per-class exact recall and any-main-TE recovery
evaluation.unknown_reporting: source Unknown/UNCLASSIFIED and AMBIGUOUS_TE bp/rows are reported in full even when excluded from primary known denominator
evaluation.d_binary: N/A for class metrics; WHOLE D output is binary material only and is not remapped into classes
evaluation.truth_boundary: same-assembly UCSC RepeatMasker is a comparator layer, not exhaustive biological truth; native unknown and source unknown are never silently treated as negative

gates.class_checkpoint: CLASS_MODEL must point to a complete validation-selected class checkpoint with pytorch_model.bin
gates.native_cells: A terminal-success EDTA/RM2 cell with its annotation output and annotation_summary.json is scored; a missing or non-terminal cell is retained as NA with its execution-state reason and never filled with zero
gates.target_input: all four target chromosomes must be present with exact source identifiers and lengths
gates.no_score_selection: target chromosomes are fixed by D exposure audit before native output or class score inspection
gates.no_gpu_without_dependency: class-map GPU job is submitted only with an afterok dependency on class checkpoint availability and target preparation
